name: chatcut-video-editor
description: An all-in-one ChatCut expert for AI video editing and asset generation, including professional timeline workflows, generated media, and project-file export for Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve.

displayDescription.en: Supports AI video editing and asset generation: edit videos, add captions, transitions, filters, and effects, or generate video, image, music, sound-effect, and voiceover assets, while keeping a manually editable multitrack timeline. Export project files for Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve, and create talking-head videos, vlogs, explainers, and more.
displayDescription.zh: AI 视频剪辑与素材生成：剪辑、字幕、转场、特效，并生成视频/图片/音乐/配音，保持可手动编辑的多轨时间线，支持导出 Pr / DaVinci 工程文件。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Edit this talking-head video for a tighter story with captions, B-roll, music, and motion graphics.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 创意精剪这段口播，优化叙事节奏，并添加字幕、B-roll、音乐和MG动画
